title: A feature closes with any one-line text as its evidence
what: relay queue done <slug> --evidence <sha> checks only that the text is one line, holds no session path and that the item is a feature (lib/relay_queue.py close_with_evidence, about line 1033). It never checks that the sha exists, that it is on the default branch, or that it carries the change, so "evidence" is the closer's word, not a fact.
why: Owner, 28 Oct, asked: "Что такое evidence ? Как ты его проставляешь ?". Principle 5 (fact to code): whether a commit exists and is on the default branch is a fact git can check. Live, 28 Oct: the front closed a-resolved-conflict-no-longer-waits-for-the-owne with --evidence $(git rev-parse master), which after a fast-forward is the last check-record commit 3379145, not a commit of the change; nothing would have refused a typo.
failing_case: In a temporary repo, `relay queue done <feature> --evidence deadbeef` closes the item though deadbeef is no commit.
pass_cases: --evidence that is not a commit of this repo is refused, naming the reason.
A commit that is not on the default branch is refused.
A commit of the default branch is accepted, stored as the full sha.
